messages:
alice: opened a small docs PR to refresh the Marlin-7B model card: add quant variant support, limits, bench numbers, and a short migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1977

ben: thanks. please be explicit about which profiles are GPU-only vs CPU-capable. customers get tripped up by generic `quant` wording.

alice: added a Compatibility section: `q8_gpu (GPU only)`, `q4_cpu (CPU+GPU, reduced throughput)`, `q4_gpu (GPU recommended)`. note about lower accuracy risk when moving to q4.

cory: can you paste the bench command and the exact tokenizer version so eng-ml can reproduce?

alice: pasted harness output:```bash
bench-run --model marlin-7b --profile q4_gpu --seq 2048 --bs 4 --tokenizer v2.1.0
# median of 3 runs
throughput: 72.3 tokens/s per GPU
p95: 310ms
memory: 9.6GB
```

ben: add a succinct SDK sample showing the variant tag, e.g. `model:"marlin-7b:quant-q4_cpu"` so people don't try `marlin-7b:quant`. also update limits table: `max_sequence_length: 8192 (q4) / 4096 (q8)`, `recommended_batch_size: 4 for q4 variants`.

alice: added example Python snippet and updated limits table. also included a short migration checklist: 1) baseline QA on holdout prompts, 2) validate latency on staging pool, 3) phased rollout with canary.

cory: tiny ask: mention streaming support and embedding compatibility. q8 doesn't support streaming in current runtime.

alice: noted: `streaming: supported for q4_gpu and q4_cpu (with higher p95 on CPU); q8_gpu: streaming not supported yet`

docs-bot: PR #1977 merged to main by alice  Changes: Marlin-7B card update, examples, bench link, migration checklist.

alice: thanks all, I'll add the `mid-llm` search tag to the catalog index next.
